findings.text: The scaffolder fills the template gate's two intentionally-blank slots (unit and dependency_audit) with na so the empty starter repo gates green; the interactive /warp:init skill remains the front door that configures real slots and protected paths with a human. The reviewer confirmed this split is honest rather than the scaffolder pre-deciding gate policy.

On an idempotent re-run only the derived specs/index.md is regenerated (AC2 explicitly exempts the one derived file from the never-overwrite guarantee). The reviewer scaffolded into a fresh dir (22 files laid), confirmed the produced repo's own scripts/verify.sh exits 0 GREEN on the empty starter plan, and a second scaffold created 0 and skipped 22 while preserving a hand-planted file.

summary: X2 (WARP-0402, warp init scaffold) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review: pass_with_notes, 0 blocking, gate GREEN (selftest 728). The reviewer scaffolded into a fresh temp dir itself - 22 files laid, the produced repository's own scripts/verify.sh exits 0 GREEN on the empty starter plan, the substrate complete, and a second scaffold created 0 and skipped 22 (idempotent, preserving a hand-planted file) - and confirmed the fail-loud paths (a gate-template drift or a failed index regeneration raises ScaffoldError). Non-tautology proven: a mutation omitting a substrate file or laying an invalid starter plan makes the green-gate assertion fail. Capabilities warp_init_scaffold=mechanical is honest (pure stdlib file-laying that reimplements no gate/validator/index logic and runs the produced gate green here); both capabilities.yaml copies byte-identical; stdlib only; proportionate (reuses the templates and the target's own generator and gate, no bespoke tooling); generic; ASCII. proof_digest recomputed via validate.py.
